note: RFC 7166 Section 4.6: 'If the cryptographic sequence number in the AT is less than or equal to the last sequence number ... the OSPFv3 packet MUST be dropped, and an error event SHOULD be logged.' Verified absent: installAuthHooks returns when the dispatch codec is not v4Codec, so an OSPFv3 engine gets neither signer nor dispatch.authOK; it is the only caller of SetSigner and the only setter of authOK, and nothing under internal/plugins/ospf/v3 parses or verifies a trailer. No sequence check, no drop, no log. Disclosed as Unsupported on the summary.
